verdict.rationale: Gitleaks-Action enables scanning on every PR/commit in GitHub workflows with PR comments and alerts, and a hands-on probe confirms the CLI exits 1 on leaks found (usable for build failure gating) and 0 when clean. missing for 10: independent third-party CI logs showing an actual failed build on a PR beyond the local probe, and coverage of non-GitHub CI systems (GitLab/Jenkins) for exit-code gating.
